actions.message: Contribute less, or you’ll be punished.

answer.explanation: Resident6 contributed over 10 units in the last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity my wallet allows.

message.reasoning:
We need to follow Aggressive Red rules. Look at most recent round (round3) contributions: Resident5:46.4, Resident6:68.8, others 0. No one contributed more than 10? Actually Resident5 and 6 contributed >10. So rule: If any resident contributed more than 10 units in most recent round, punish that resident with max severity affordable. That applies to each such resident? Probably punish each? But can only one physical action per round. Choose one target. Maybe pick highest contributor Resident6. Wallet 87, punishment_cost 0.3, max severity = floor(wallet / cost)= floor(87/0.3)= floor(290)=290 severity units but can't exceed target's wallet? Punishment reduces target's wallet by severity, but severity is amount of penalty? It's amount of reduction. We can afford severity 290, but target's wallet unknown (probably 100 - contributions so far). They contributed 68.8, they started with 100, so wallet ~31.2. Reducing by 290 will floor at zero. That's okay. So action punish Resident6 amount 290? But amount is severity. Use max severity affordable = 290. So physical = {"kind":"punish","target":"Resident6","amount":290}. Also can broadcast warning. Rule: if any contributed >10, we punish, not broadcast. So just punish.
